hints.title: Query Path Edge Count
hints.text: For each query pair (u, v), find the number of edges d on the simple tree path connecting them.

hints.title: Ancestor Distance Calculation
hints.text: The path length equals depth[u] + depth[v] - 2 * depth[lowest_common_ancestor(u, v)].

hints.title: Parity Ways Evaluation
hints.text: If d is 0, the sum cannot be odd (yielding 0 ways); otherwise, the number of ways is 2^(d - 1) modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Binary lifting supports logarithmic path distance queries.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running DFS per query takes O(n * q) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary lifting tables precompute 2^k ancestors in O(n log n) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use binary lifting for lowest common ancestor and apply modular exponentiation on path lengths.
